name: usage-report
what: Reports token use per transcript, counts each API response once, and flags sessions that pass the request or context limit.

faults.fault: Placeholder lines count as requests, so idle sessions look busier than they were.
Only the request count is checked, so a session with a huge context is never flagged.
Repeated lines of one response are counted as separate requests.
Old files are no longer skipped by modification time.
